candidates.statement: Studying these connections further should, on the one hand, provide a dynamical framework for division algebraic descriptions of the standard model and, on the other hand, give restrictions for possible matter models which can be realized as causal fermion systems.
As we shall see, the vacuum configuration can be described naturally using octonions.
Analyzing these questions in more detail should also give new insight into the rigidity of the particle model in the theory of causal fermion systems.
Since the predominant focus of the present paper is connecting causal fermion systems to the octonions, in what follows we shall disregard the factor of $\mathbb{H}$ in $\mathbb{T}$.

An example of how the left associative multiplication algebra of the (complex) octonions may be used to represent one generation of standard model fermions with unbroken $SU(3)\times U(1)$ symmetry was given in [\[Furey\]](#Furey){reference-type="ref" reference="Furey"}.
In this way, octonions should be helpful for getting a better understanding of and giving an explanation for the choice of the vacuum configuration in causal fermion systems.
